notes.title: User created level are offline
notes.content:
Ichi launched in 2014, after five years we have decided to sunset the support for the user created features. This means you can no longer play or submit user created levels.

If you recently bought Ichi, and are disappointed with this news, we urge you to ask Steam for a refund. We have updated the store page to reflect this change so that new customers are aware of the lack of user created levels.

We want to thank all of you for supporting the game over the last years. It's been incredible to see the community create hundreds of thousands of levels for such a tiny game. All good things come to an end, unfortunately.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
We're very happy to announce the first steam update for Ichi. Thanks to your feedback we've added some great new features.

- Partial controller support
- Big Picture Mode
- Hold SHIFT (windows) or OPTION (mac) at start up to choose resolution.
- Minor bug fixes
- Now with more than 20,000 levels!

notes.title: Over 19,000 levels created! Show us yours!
notes.content:
The Ichi community has created over 19,000 levels. There are lots of amazing levels, and lots of very weird ones!

We'd love to see your creations, so don't hesitate to share them on the community page!
